'''Vanel''' was a representative of the mining company [[Mon Tondievz, Ltd.]] She was later discovered to be part of an [[Eldratz]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] ring. A former member of [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence's]] [[Destabilization]] branch, she owned a personal [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]] called [[Eradicator E8U]].
